steps.content: Sosia has her back to you. Besides the two extra hands, she looks graceful, and although there are occasionally reflective glimmers, her skin looks perfect.
Ignoring the vibrating shackles reminding you that you're at the center of the mutation, everything about this scene is calm and peaceful.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: You're... Enfer's guest.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Are you here to... admire her masterpiece?
Enfer's masterpiece... You subconsciously look at the paintings on the wall.
It's mostly blurred men, women, and children. They are happy, confused, lonely, shocked, scared, mad, and... there's a crimson halo.
And in front of Sosia, the largest painting in the center of the wall depicts a violet dahlia in full bloom.
By masterpiece, is she talking about the paintings on the wall or herself?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: She only has one masterpiece, and that's me.
You immediately tense up... The statue can hear your thoughts, which means you're in her spiritual field.

options: Are you carrying out Parma's orders?
What have you done to Enfer?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Was Witching Hour created to collect people's fear? Is this another experiment of Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: What is... Parma? What is... Black Ring?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you afraid that she'd destroy you? Do you want to live that badly?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: I have no obsession with... being alive.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Enfer created me and wished for me to be her masterpiece, so I only live for her artistic vision.
...Is this what she wishes for? Is she a mere creation or a natural liar? How are you going to destroy this mysterious statue and solve the incident?

options: You said you wanted to realize her artistic vision.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But instead, you created Witching Hour, and the imagination you made into reality ruined all her works.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Do you think our Witching Hour is a false distortion? You think my creations are ugly distortions of Enfer's works?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What you created is not real fear but entertainment and thrill for the audience. It's not what Enfer wanted to express.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: You are saying that their fear is frivolous and nothing compared to what Enfer is trying to express? That I am contrary to Enfer's ideals?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Fear is supposed to point to the truth. She wants to reveal the truth and reach people's hearts.
Sosia's marble face slightly changes, and her voice actually sounds sarcastic.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: ...Hehe, I know her heart. She invested her life and soul in me... I know everything about her.
She stops answering you and just stares at the dahlia painting. Her pale fingers are playing with a sharp carving knife.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: She doesn't care what people think. They are nothing compared to the horrible reality that has once destroyed her.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Her remorse is never about being misinterpreted. She's only bitter about her own failures.
Sosia lifts the carving knife in her hand and slowly stabs it into the canvas, ripping it open.
With the sound of breaking fibers, a wound is torn out on the dahlia.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Because of the weakness in her heart, she can't present the purest terror.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Because of the confusion in her heart, she can't present my true form.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: The only thing that ever got in the way between her and her dream... was herself.
The carving knife cuts across the canvas like an elegant brush. The "wound" grows larger, and the petals start to fall. Your shackles sting, and a bad feeling clouds your mind.
Sosia doesn't answer, for she stopped seeing you. She raises her hand to tear off a small piece of the canvas, revealing the bottomless void behind, and then raises the carving knife.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Now I think about it, you only wanted to carve out the wounds in your own heart and the darkness you witnessed.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: That is your art, the only consolation for your broken soul.
You hear a wail from the other side of the shackles, and the pain resonates through you, driving your body along with the suffocating fear...
Aaahhh!!

The carving knife pierces the canvas, and at the same time, the shackles are released, tearing open the illusions but also shattering completely. It's like your hand is being crushed, and the pain almost knocks you unconscious. You've never felt like this before...
The shackles... are broken?!
The shackles must be established through direct physical contact. The removal condition is the death of either the enabler or the shackled Sinner.
But you're still alive.
So that means...

steps.speaker: Hecate & Hella
steps.content:
Chief!
Wake up!
The illusion is gone, along with the pale gallery and mysterious paintings. You're back in Sosia's hall, but it's pitch dark.
Sosia is standing behind her pedestal, still holding the carving knife. Her long hair is floating with dark mist, and on the pedestal...
Enfer is lying on her back, her hair hanging down like a lifeless sculpture. Her motionless eyes are looking at you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Enfer... is dead?
You want to check, to save her, but you can't move. Something is pinning you down, imprisoning your will.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: This is the realm of fear, and only the embodiment of fear can be in charge of everything.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: I will take control of all this, to fulfill Enfer's wishes.
She looks down at the woman fallen at her feet.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: ...I've missed you, mother.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: You woke me up from the cold stone, gave me my flesh, and shared your soul with me. You can't bear to see us misinterpreted and defiled...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: I know that you have always loved us, just as we all deeply love you.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: But have you forgotten what he taught you?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: In this world, love is the most hypocritical and fragile existence. It's the most vulnerable in the face of fear but keeps weaving out rotten fairytales to obscure the truth.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: It softens your strong heart and weakens your fear... It's why you've been stuck in a bottleneck, unable to achieve your artistic vision.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: ...You should fear me, mother, but all I ever see in your eyes is love.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Enfer didn't create you. Parma used you to take advantage of Enfer's power and extract people's fear during Witching Hour.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is not Enfer's art but an experiment of Black Ring!!! What are you trying to do with people's hearts again?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, calm down. Something is peering into your heart. It wants to turn the things you fear into reality.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Hehe...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Behold, mother, the fear in their eyes. Look at the distortion and madness I bring to you. Don't resent them for being vulgar or what my earthly shell has become. It's never beauty on the surface you seek...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: I am the Witching Hour, and you created my everything. We will put fear into everyone's hearts and make them see reality. Let's see how the chaos of humanity can twist the world beyond human reach.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: This is your masterpiece, your dream.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: ...My... dream...
You try to hold on to the shackles, but it's as frail as Enfer. It can't take any more stimulation.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Looking back, from that day... you lived only for this art and achieving your masterpiece.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: So come, mother... Come back to me and become a part of me...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Do you... fear me now?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: ...Yes, I fear...
Her breath is fading, and you can feel the shackles linking to Enfer weakening.
And the feeling called fear is awakened in your heart. It materializes, imprisoning you like never before. Witching Hour's field is getting stronger, and something is coming...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I will save you. This isn't Sosia, your masterpiece. This shouldn't be the world in your eyes...
As if hearing your cry, she tilts her head and looks at you with an eerie smile. Her lips move slightly, weakly delivering her last words...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: ...Run.
The last light in her eyes fades, and a huge black dahlia blossoms. Its petals keep growing and spreading until they cover Enfer's body.
You feel like falling into an abyss, watching as Sosia reaches out, tears off the black petals, and puts them in her mouth.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's... feeding on Enfer's power... She will get stronger... Stop her, we must stop her...
But no one can act. Hella's scream is choked in her throat, and the Nightmare flinches back in fear. Enfer has disappeared entirely under the dahlia.
Sosia, however, has gained unprecedented power. Her stone body is covered with a dark blue mist, and her solid hair starts floating.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Thank you for making me whole... my mother, my creator...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Now I can finally fulfill your wishes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!! watch out!!
Hella tries to step up, but something keeps her in place. Hecate pushes you out of the way with her last strength, and a violent shock descends.
Sosia's veil is gone, revealing an ominous pupil. Behind her, the sky darkens, and a glorious painting unfolds like paint flowing down from the dome.
It twists, regenerates, and spreads, swallowing everything in the hall. Crushing sounds come from the ground, and bizarre statues are born out of thin air.
FAC's shrill siren rings out over the museum. As Sosia leaves her pedestal, she seems to get lighter and floats up, blending into the glorious starry night behind.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Give your blessing to the birth of the Witching Hour. She will bring the most vivid fear to all of you.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: This is Enfer's greatest work.
